independent_review.text:
# Independent review: radio 28-use successor and five individual decisions

Scope: exact b6ef5d7d94a7a7a2b3d65beb8115ffd2e1223e5c base; radio28-v2.patch SHA-256 5224eb29105e494a9f538578083eb4065a5c52c76aa6c5c358dd74b316dd8de3 and individual-five-v2.patch SHA-256 89075516d3293bd40500f04e28d6d86d8e37a94efca9b1b47c350fe73b795150. Both apply with `--whitespace=error`; independently reconstructed private-index trees are 4d1d9e8252b0ee91e6844a1ea2f66848c0a32e70 and 6e1626ccc7944659353a12bb7796874c106fa92c respectively. Two diagnostic log JSON wrappers decode byte-for-byte to the original ANSI logs and match their stated lengths and hashes. Checker source-identity validation authenticates wrappers; it does not decode or decide the semantic truth of the logs.

The 28 changes are exactly the registered radio-base triples, preserve row order and the complete prior ledger rows. The prior e3365e7b338c80cb0b539fb19cb1c8c20d0741f37d4c11f2f46f8620aaec3fbf radio-base image is the actual 6597b9319 source; the current b6ef image is 8cdd88d202dce54dcde31ac0f9bda0f3e73726b8b611cab4fbcf7cbf4375a147. Their actual complete diff contains only the three nullable ARIA declaration widenings and the required setter change notification. All ten archived declaration payloads independently match their installed 22.1.7 bytes. `BooleanInput` is an owned union, not the peer @docs-private type. MAT_RADIO_GROUP and MAT_RADIO_DEFAULT_OPTIONS imports in the base are unused; the outer component's peer-token use and shared identity have separate retained support. Previous packed/browser receipts remain at their original source and artifact epochs.

For the five full upstream SHAs, retained census raw commits matched Git object bytes and SHA-256; complete Git changed-file sets matched census (0af3:10, eba6:3, a62e:7, 8417:10, ff905:3). Each embedded full diff independently matched `git show --format= --no-ext-diff` bytes, with matching path and hunk header inventory. The five proposed rows retain their exact prior ledger rows, and ledger ordering is unchanged. The source decision is supported within these limits:

* 0af3 adds disabledInteractive and independently moves default disabled pointer handling and changes click listener/bubbling/lifecycle. Owned radio retains the 16 template-bound stopPropagation listener; the source-based decision and historical host-point comparison explicitly do not claim full enabled bubbling or destruction testing.
* 8417 adds focusable aria-disabled opt-in and associated click/reset/ripple behavior to current checkbox. Owned 16 checkbox has native disabled input and no new opt-in. This preserves legacy behavior, not a claim that the new peer feature exists.
* ff905 changes disabled forced-color opacity, frame, checkmark, mixed mark and label colors. The retained Chromium 156 comparison tested four forced-colors states on older 2cf artifact and tagged16; both matched for recorded properties. It is not a universal contrast or accessibility proof, nor a fresh b6ef browser run.
* eba6 widens three ARIA types to nullable. The committed owned type declarations now match that shape; prior e066 artifact demonstrated strict nullable bindings and runtime attribute removal. Existing source/runtime identity and AOT/number-negative evidence remain tied to their original artifacts.
* a62e removes the modern MDC touch-target click listener and wraps the input with its label, with corresponding internal form-field and style changes. The owned historical radio already wraps its input with a label and does not bind that MDC touch-target method. This is a source-scoped conclusion, not screen-reader qualification.

No claim of semantic correctness follows merely from checker acceptance. Exact source identity and consistent review text cannot prove source relevance or a judgment's truth. Extra specialist metadata is non-authoritative unless covered by its owner guard. No actual assistive-technology, all forced-colors palettes, 21.x, security clearance, full audit, release or full product gate is established.

The exact V2 afterimages match all 19 radio and 16 individual paths in the independently reconstructed Git trees. The unchanged production checker on the exact b6ef shadow changed the authored-use insufficient set from 282 to 254: exactly the targeted 28 removed, none added; source, capsule and foreign-line mutations each reopened all 28. The five individual decisions removed exactly their five SHAs from the baseline insufficient/evidence union (817 to 812), with no additions; changed upstream diff, current source and branch mutations each reopened all five. I independently recomputed these set relationships from the retained full producer JSON; both baseline and candidate overall CLI exits were nonzero for unrelated aggregate obligations. The 28 complete prior source reviews are byte-structurally preserved. Production control status receipts are radio-production-state.json SHA-256 03d9d870fb7c8e4004cf819225ec9affb06d813a807af51991104895a0f73774 and production-state.json SHA-256 b17cef7588d6fdd6bd2ee23afdee66fe913b481dafe6cc35dd4cbc813a987588. The reports and shadow depend on the pinned but linked node_modules; no independent full dependency closure or product runtime was rerun.

These two distinct patches target the same b6ef base. Later canonical commits require an explicit reconciled application; this review does not assert application or source freshness on a later HEAD.
